programmes.name: Data Science, BS
programmes.duration: 120 credit hours; confirm your full-time study plan
programmes.description: A named data science bachelor combining computing, mathematics and statistics to analyse real datasets.
programmes.curriculum: Calculus, linear algebra, programming, statistical inference, data mining and machine learning; focus areas include business analytics, biosciences, spatial and social data.
programmes.practical: Applied data-analysis coursework; an internship placement is not guaranteed by this record.

programmes.name: Biomedical Informatics and Data Science, BS
programmes.duration: 120 credit hours; confirm your full-time study plan
programmes.description: A data-focused bachelor combining computing, biology and health systems to improve clinical and population-health decisions.
programmes.curriculum: Population and clinical informatics, clinical decision analysis, knowledge representation, biomedical artificial intelligence and health data mining.
programmes.practical: Faculty research opportunities in areas including bioinformatics and digital health; participation and internships are not guaranteed.
programmes.campus: Downtown Phoenix campus — College of Health Solutions

programmes.name: Data Science, Bachelor of Science Major
programmes.description: A named data science major combining computer science, mathematics and statistics. Students enter the faculty before declaring the major.
programmes.curriculum: Data structures and algorithms, data science tools, real-world datasets, linear algebra and statistical computing; the degree requires 120 credit hours.
programmes.practical: Eligible students may apply to co-op after second-year requirements; acceptance and a work placement are not guaranteed.

programmes.name: Statistics, Bachelor of Science Major
programmes.description: A statistics major centred on collecting, modelling and interpreting data. This is a Statistics degree, not a degree titled Data Science.
programmes.curriculum: Statistical computing, data collection, stochastic processes, quality control, time series, survival data and experimental design.
programmes.practical: Optional co-op can include three or four four-month work terms and usually adds a year; admission and placements are conditional.

programmes.name: Computer Science, BSc Major
programmes.description: A computing major with data mining and artificial-intelligence opportunities. Its official degree title is Computer Science.
programmes.curriculum: Programming, discrete mathematics, calculus, databases, computer architecture, ethics, data structures, linear algebra, software engineering, operating systems and networks.
programmes.practical: Co-op, faculty-supervised research and practical project opportunities; access and placements require individual confirmation.

programmes.name: Technical Computer Science, BSc
programmes.description: Study how software, algorithms, hardware and networks work. Data Science and Artificial Intelligence is available as an elective within this computing degree.
programmes.curriculum: Software and network systems, data and information, discrete structures, efficient algorithms, interactive technologies, electives and a final design and research semester.
programmes.practical: Team projects include real-client software; an internship module is an option. Final study includes a design project and individual research.

programmes.name: Statistical Sciences — Stats&Maths curriculum
languages: Italian — check the curriculum language mix
programmes.description: An undergraduate statistics and mathematics curriculum for analysing data. It is distinct from Bologna’s Data Science master degree.
programmes.curriculum: Mathematics, probability, computing and statistics, then statistical inference, models, high-dimensional data, time series and sample surveys.
programmes.practical: Applied analysis and computing; a specific internship or placement is not verified.

programmes.name: Finance, Bachelor of Science (Economics and Business Administration)
programmes.qualification: Bachelor of Science (Economics and Business Administration)
programmes.duration: 3-year bachelor; optional 2-year master continuation subject to conditions
programmes.credits: 180 ECTS bachelor; master continuation is a separate 120 ECTS
programmes.description: An English-taught finance bachelor connecting investments and corporate decisions with economics, analytics and quantitative methods.
programmes.curriculum: Financial markets, investment analysis, risk management, company valuation, corporate financial strategy and modelling with financial data.
programmes.practical: Applied quantitative work on real financial problems and teamwork; a specific internship is not guaranteed.
programmes.campus: Otaniemi campus, Espoo — School of Business

routes.name: Kazakhstan — qualifying NIS Grade 12 diploma
routes.applicant: Kazakhstan applicant with a foreign secondary qualification
routes.eligibility: The Kazakhstan rule lists NIS Grade 12 with at least three Higher Level subjects graded A, B or C, including advanced/higher mathematics. Technical Computer Science also requires Mathematics B equivalence, English proof and mandatory matching.
routes.recognition: A standard Kazakhstan Grade 11 Attestat without NIS Grade 12 is explicitly not directly admissible. Confirm another recognised qualification or additional preparation; progression is not guaranteed.
routes.subjects: Mathematics equivalent to Dutch Mathematics B is required. Matching includes a questionnaire on interests and algorithmic, mathematical and logical thinking, plus an event; its advice is not binding.

IELTS.detail: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall and at least 5.5 in each section; other listed certificates may be used.

ENGLISH.detail: Kazakhstan has no country-based English exemption; submit an accepted certificate.

tuition.note: 2027/28 higher institutional non-EU/EEA rate; Technical Computer Science is explicitly in this group. Individual exemptions may differ.

routes.mandatoryFees: Mandatory fees not fully verified; request an itemised schedule for your intake.
routes.living: Twente fee page checked 16 November 2026 gives an estimated EUR 1,311 per month excluding tuition, based on Nibud; this is not a housing quote.
routes.nextAction: Confirm your NIS or other diploma and Mathematics B equivalence, then complete Studielink, Osiris and mandatory matching.

routes.name: Non-EU resident abroad — SAT selection reference
routes.applicant: Kazakhstan citizen residing outside Italy, non-EU quota applicant
routes.eligibility: Historical 2026/27 call: suitable foreign diploma after at least 12 years of schooling, university access in the awarding country and SAT selection. Non-EU residents abroad had 10 reserved first-intake places. Future rules are unconfirmed.
routes.recognition: A Kazakhstan Grade 11 Attestat alone does not establish the required 12 years. Ask Bologna which additional recognised study or qualification is acceptable; a foundation or progression route is not guaranteed here.
routes.subjects: Mathematics and logical reasoning; SAT Mathematics below 400/800 triggers additional learning obligations in the 2026/27 call, not automatic rejection.

SAT.detail: 2026/27 call requires SAT taken on or after 1 February 2024, with official College Board delivery by the applicant’s intake deadline; ranking uses SAT scores.

IELTS.detail: The 2026/27 call assesses B1 English through SAT rather than asking for IELTS; recheck the next call.

TOEFL.detail: The 2026/27 call assesses B1 English through SAT rather than asking for TOEFL; recheck the next call.

ENGLISH.detail: B1 English is required and assessed through the English-language SAT in this historical call. This is not a route without English assessment.

tuition.note: 2026/27 fees depend on the university’s financial assessment; no exact Kazakhstan-applicant amount is verified. Do not assume a minimum or a grant.

routes.mandatoryFees: 2026/27 selection application costs EUR 20; enrolment charges and other mandatory fees require a current individual assessment.
routes.living: Living costs not verified; request a separate housing, food, insurance and travel budget.
routes.nextAction: Request written diploma-equivalence advice and the next Stats&Maths SAT call before paying for an application.
questions: Confirm a recognised solution for any missing school year, the curriculum teaching-language mix and the next non-EU call.

routes.name: Foreign school diploma — SAT/ACT round A
routes.applicant: Kazakhstan applicant educated outside the destination country
routes.eligibility: Foreign upper-secondary qualification granting corresponding higher-education eligibility in its awarding country, plus SAT or ACT. Applicants are ranked by test results; minima are eligibility thresholds.
routes.recognition: Foreign qualification must grant higher-education eligibility in the awarding country. Aalto evaluates submitted documents; translate originals into Finnish, Swedish or English. Kazakhstan diploma acceptance is not pre-certified in this catalogue.
routes.subjects: Strong mathematics and quantitative reasoning support finance study; this is the business admission category, not the higher technology SAT threshold.

SAT.detail: SAT at least 1200 overall or ACT at least 25 composite. SAT or ACT required for round A; test completed 1 January 2025 or later. Minima do not guarantee selection.

ACT.detail: SAT at least 1200 overall or ACT at least 25 composite. Official results must arrive by deadline.

IELTS.detail: This admission round explicitly does not require a language test result.

TOEFL.detail: This admission round explicitly does not require a language test result.

ENGLISH.detail: Sufficient English ability is expected, but a separate language test result is explicitly not required for this route.

tuition.note: Bachelor fee for non-EU/EEA fee-liable students; schedule applies to study rights starting 1 Aug 2025 onward. Master tuition differs and is additional.

routes.mandatoryFees: Normally EUR100 application fee for non-EU/EEA/Swiss applicants, subject to exemptions. Student Union and healthcare fees are additional; 2026 healthcare fee EUR36/semester, future fees need checking.
